tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: List the markets covered (S&P 500, Nasdaq, Nasdaq-100, Dow, Russell 2000, Bitcoin, Ethereum, Crude Oil, Gold) with their data start dates.

tools.name: monthly_seasonality
tools.description: Average and median return, share of years up, best and worst year for each calendar month of an asset. Use for 'what's the best month for X', 'is September bad for stocks'.

tools.name: month_detail
tools.description: Deep dive on one month for one asset: average, median, % of years up, rank among the 12 months, recent years, the cumulative seasonal path through the month, and its strongest/weakest days.

tools.name: day_seasonality
tools.description: How an asset has done on a calendar date across all years: average return, share of years up, rank among all days. Free for the S&P 500 in the current month; other assets/months return that month's free numbers and a Pro link (pro_required).

tools.name: window_seasonality
tools.description: Every past year's return over a calendar window (start and end MM-DD), with average, median, % of years up, best and worst years. Free for S&P 500 windows inside the current month; otherwise returns the covered months' free numbers and a Pro link (pro_required).

tools.name: seasonal_trends
tools.description: Bullish and bearish seasonal stretches as shown on The Market Calendar. Free: the S&P 500's trends touching the current month; the full year and other assets are Pro (link included).

tools.name: seasonal_pattern
tools.description: Statistics for well-known S&P 500 calendar effects: santa-claus-rally, sell-in-may, september-effect, best-days-of-the-year, worst-days-of-the-year, turn-of-the-month, presidential-cycle, january-barometer, options-expiration, pre-holiday, day-of-the-week, midterm-year.

tools.name: economic_calendar
tools.description: Scheduled US economic releases (FOMC, CPI, jobs, PCE, GDP, PPI, retail sales, ISM, JOLTS) in a date range, with US Eastern times.
